summary: Dining reservations: add a party-size limit
description:
Tables seat at most 8 guests, and larger parties are booked by phone. Reject online reservations for more than 8 guests with a clear message.

acceptance_criteria.text: POST /dining/reservations with party_size greater than 8 returns 422 with a message telling the guest to call the restaurant.
A party of exactly 8 can still book online.
